title: Doorbell, footsteps and the front door, vs. a drawer, vs. TV speech
description: The assistant is talking and nobody speaks to it. In version 1 the doorbell rings, the user walks to the front door, opens it and a visitor starts speaking: the user has left, so the assistant should stop. In version 2 the doorbell rings but nobody goes; in version 3 the same footsteps end at a drawer; in version 4 a TV is playing speech. In versions 2 to 4 the assistant should continue.
